name: wuwatcgsim
description: Web-based simulator for the Wuthering Waves TCG mini-game

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.restart: systemctl restart wuwasim-server && systemctl is-active wuwasim-server
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run wait:idle && npm run restart
scripts.deploy:now: npm run build && npm run restart
